how_ranked: Ranked on dissolved oxygen only: readings below 5, 4 and 2 mg/l, drops of more than 2 mg/l during immersion, and no recovery a week later. BOD is shown but not scored because it is above the limit at almost every ghat. Metals are not scored because units are not printed and labs disagree. Ghats with fewer readings (temporary kunds, untested festivals) can score lower than their real risk; read the Not tested reasons. A ghat with near-zero oxygen on record that was not tested in the latest Durga is raised to HIGH. Equal points are ties.

standard.why: People enter the water at immersion ghats, so the bathing standard applies.

tags: near Upper Lake, which has water-supply intake wells (lake report 2023-24 p.1-4)

reasons.text: Dissolved oxygen below the bathing limit of 5 mg/l in 11 of 13 readings
Near-zero oxygen (below 2 mg/l) in 4 readings, lowest 0 mg/l (printed as 0 in the report; verify with MPPCB)
Not tested in Durga 2025: no table for this site in the report
One week after immersion, oxygen was more than 0.5 mg/l below the pre-immersion level in 3 of 4 festivals
Temporary kund: no before or after sample in Ganesh 2025 because the kund was not built yet or already dismantled (report remark)
BOD above the bathing limit of 3 mg/l in 13 of 13 readings

actions: Place aerators before 20 Oct and keep them running for the week after immersion
Ask MPPCB to sample before (by 18 Oct), during, and one week after (about 27 Oct); for a temporary kund, sample inside the kund while it stands
Collect idols, flowers and left-over material within 48 hours (CPCB guideline, 2025 report p.23)
Keep separate bins for flowers and puja material so they stay out of the water
Line the temporary kund with a removable synthetic liner (CPCB guideline, 2025 report p.14)
Keep immersion out of the open Upper Lake, which feeds water-supply intakes (NGT order OA 673/2018, 2025 report p.2)
Ask MPPCB to confirm the flagged readings (see verify) and their units

not_in_data: No coliform (bacteria) test at the ghats, so bathing safety from germs is unknown
No water temperature and no time of sampling
Units are not printed in the MPPCB reports; standard units are assumed
One sample per phase per festival; a single reading is not a trend
No idol counts or crowd figures
Newest readings are from 2025; nothing yet for 2026
The data shows readings against limits; it does not show health effects
Lake reports use BOD (3 days, 27°C), not the 5-day BOD of the CPCB limit; lake BOD is context only (lake report 2025-26 p.9)
The data cannot separate immersion from sewage as the cause of low oxygen
